verify.note: sim of the regenerated request, 180s, seed 1 (seed 1000003 within 1.1)

summary: Frostbolt build with Fingers of Frost and Shatter. Its 29 Arcane points take Arcane Mind, Arcane Instability and Arcane Blast for spell damage.
rotation: Cooldowns (Demonic Rune, racial) on a free GCD
Evocation below 20% mana with more than 90s left (almost never fires)
Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge. The boss counts as Frozen, so it does 3 times the damage and gets Shatter's crit.
Arcane Blast to 2 stacks every 15s for 30% of Intellect as spell damage
Arcane Missiles on a Missile Barrage proc
Ice Lance instead when a Frostbolt would not land before the end (its cast plus 1s)
Wand when nothing else can be cast (out of mana)
consumes: Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost (staff imbue, on top of the oil)
caveats: Ice Lance's spell power coefficient is 0.429, the Season of Discovery value. The client has 0.
Frostbolt X's base damage is ×1.04 the client's value.
Winter's Chill only comes from Cone of Cold, so the build skips it.
Assumed: raid bosses can't be frozen. When Fingers of Frost charges apply is unknown.
No Ahn'Qiraj book ranks (Fireball XI, Frostbolt X, Arcane Missiles VII). They would add 50 DPS to Frost, 30 to Arcane, 17 to Fire and 0 to Frostfire.
notes: Request written by mksettings -spec mage_frost unchanged (shared level 60 raid with Mana Spring Totem and Blessing of Wisdom in place of Might; Mage Armor; Engineering/Tailoring). It carries the spec's staff imbue scroll (Scroll of Imbue Greater Frost) as a mage option, as the preset does. Its rotation casts Ice Lance on every Fingers of Frost charge.
